intro: Almost half the people living in Luxembourg are foreign citizens, and most people speak several languages.

chapters.title: Three languages
text: Luxembourgish is the national language, while French and German are used in government, schools and newspapers; many people also speak English. Portuguese people form the largest foreign community, and around 200,000 workers cross the border from France, Belgium and Germany every day.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: In 2020 Luxembourg became the first country to make all public transport free.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who lives in one country and works in another.
